question.text: The engine of a truck moving along a straight road delivers constant power. The distance travelled by the truck in time $t$ is proportional to

solution.text:
$\frac{\mathrm{mv}^{2}}{\mathrm{t}}=\frac{\mathrm{ms}^{2}}{\mathrm{t}^{3}}$

since both $\mathrm{P}$ and $\mathrm{m}$ are constants

$\therefore \frac{\mathrm{s}^{2}}{\mathrm{t}^{3}}=$ constant
